setup: none  -- multi-statement pins: query lines map 1:1 to ' | '-separated observed segments

pins.claim: Bare ORDER BY x is ASC with NULLS LAST
pins.query: SELECT x FROM (VALUES (2),(NULL),(1)) t(x) ORDER BY x

pins.claim: ORDER BY x DESC also puts NULLS LAST — DuckDB's default null order is a setting (nulls_last), not tied to direction like PostgreSQL
pins.query: SELECT x FROM (VALUES (2),(NULL),(1)) t(x) ORDER BY x DESC

pins.claim: Explicit NULLS FIRST/LAST spellings are accepted in both directions
pins.query:
SELECT x FROM (VALUES (2),(NULL),(1)) t(x) ORDER BY x ASC NULLS FIRST
SELECT x FROM (VALUES (2),(NULL),(1)) t(x) ORDER BY x DESC NULLS FIRST

pins.claim: Window ORDER BY has the same default null placement as top-level ORDER BY
pins.query: SELECT x, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY x) AS rn FROM (VALUES (2),(NULL),(1)) t(x) ORDER BY rn

pins.claim: Default window frame with ORDER BY is RANGE UNBOUNDED PRECEDING .. CURRENT ROW: peer rows (tied order key) share the running value
pins.query: SELECT k, v, sum(v) OVER (ORDER BY k) AS s FROM (VALUES (1,10),(1,20),(2,5)) t(k,v) ORDER BY k, v

pins.claim: Explicit ROWS frame distinguishes the peers — proves the previous pin measured RANGE, not ROWS
pins.query: SELECT k, v, sum(v) OVER (ORDER BY k, v ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS s FROM (VALUES (1,10),(1,20),(2,5)) t(k,v) ORDER BY k, v

pins.claim: Window aggregate with PARTITION BY and no ORDER BY spans the whole partition
pins.query: SELECT k, sum(v) OVER (PARTITION BY k) AS s FROM (VALUES (1,10),(1,20),(2,5)) t(k,v) ORDER BY k, v
